title: Peruvian Ceviche
description: A refreshing and zesty Peruvian ceviche dish made with fresh seafood and a tangy marinade.
instructions: Cut the fish into small pieces and place in a shallow dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together the yellow corn kernels, pickled red onion, tiradito sauce, cilantro, and lime juice.
Pour the marinade over the fish and mix well to coat.
Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the fish to 'cook' in the marinade.
Just before serving, season with salt to taste.
Serve the ceviche chilled, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
